## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (no public API change)
- [ ] New feature (additive public API change)
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Docs, tooling or tests only

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (core changes keep 100% coverage of branches)
- [ ] A changeset was added with `pnpm changeset` if a published package changed
- [ ] Docs (README, JSDoc) are updated when the public API changed
